passages.text: Office hours are 8:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday to Friday.
For domestic business trips, lodging is reimbursed up to NT$2,800 per night, and receipts are required.
Employees receive 7 days of annual leave after one year of service and 10 days after two years.
Business trips should use high-speed rail or trains; taxi use must be explained.
